A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DeCo study. The main text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices support comparison despite relocated material and renumbered references.

before.justification: v1 reports original ImageNet generation experiments, GenEval and DPG-Bench evaluations, architectural ablations, and frequency-spectrum analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results and adds an experiment evaluating DeCo without REPA.

M1.justification: Equation (9) revises the stated decoder modulation from gamma*h to (1+gamma)*h. This is a limited change to the written decoder rule; the architecture, default losses, and inference procedures otherwise remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish an implementation change or rerun.

E1.justification: Both versions use ImageNet at 256×256 and 512×512, BLIP3o training data, and GenEval/DPG-Bench evaluation. The multilingual examples are retained. The new REPA ablation introduces no dataset, task, or input scenario.

E2.justification: Table 1 adds 'DeCo w/o REPA' as an internal comparison variant. Its external comparators, including DiT-L/2, PixDDT, PixNerd, PixelFlow, and JiT+REPA, remain unchanged, as do the external comparator sets in Tables 2 and 3.

E3.justification: Table 1 expands the evaluation design with a control omitting REPA under the existing 200k-iteration ImageNet comparison protocol. Retained experiments keep their training budgets, metrics, sampling settings, and guidance procedures. Setup paragraphs moved into Appendix B do not represent changed settings.

E4.justification: The new REPA-removal ablation directly tests dependence on representation alignment: Table 1 reports FID 67.55 without REPA versus 31.35 for full DeCo. The six Table 4 ablations and existing feature-clustering, spectrum, and training-efficiency analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, experimental seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The added result uses the same point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: Table 1 adds no-REPA results: FID 67.55, sFID 10.58, IS 19.10, and recall 0.56. Table 2 removes the 600-epoch Euler DeCo-XL/16 row with FID 1.78; the 600-epoch Heun result of 1.69 remains. Other matched results, including headline ImageNet and text-to-image scores, are unchanged.

T1.justification: Equation (9) adds a unit offset to the modulation factor. New Appendix A also introduces x0=x_low+Delta and a JiT-style velocity expression. That expression equals (x0-xt)/t, opposite in sign to the velocity defined by Eqs. (2)-(3), creating an internal mathematical inconsistency. No theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the frequency-decoupled architecture, frequency-aware flow-matching loss, and quality/efficiency claims. Headline claims remain ImageNet FIDs of 1.62 and 2.22 and GenEval 0.86. The expanded JiT explanation does not change these central contributions.

C2.justification: New Appendix A explains DeCo as an implicitly learned high-frequency shortcut, contrasting its low-frequency DiT representation with JiT's explicit clean-image prediction. Section 3.4 removes the text-encoder analogy and the explicit patch-size comparison with PixelFlow. Existing native-resolution and aspect-ratio future-work qualifications remain.

D1.justification: v2 removes the project-page address from the title area while retaining the same code-repository URL. Training configurations, hardware, sampling details, prompts, and pseudocode remain available after relocation. The removed link changes access information without establishing that any resource became unavailable.

R1.justification: After matching renumbered and duplicate references, v2 adds eleven works, including PixelGen, MagCache, U-DiTs, and U-REPA. It adds a PixelGen discussion and expands positioning relative to JiT through Appendix A. The overall related-work framework remains intact.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized prose edits, changes conditioning notation from c to x_low, moves experimental setup paragraphs into the appendix, and adds acknowledgments and a JiT subsection. References move before the supplement. Most prose and the main section sequence remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 3 is redrawn with updated labels, and new Figure 7 illustrates low-frequency components, details, and noisy input. Tables and figures are repositioned as the document reflows. Existing spectrum and training plots, quantization tables, and image galleries retain their content.

improvement.justification: The added REPA-removal control supplies previously missing evidence about dependence on representation alignment, modestly improving empirical transparency. The principal benchmark evidence remains intact. This gain is limited by removal of one intermediate training result and the new Appendix A velocity formula's sign inconsistency with the main formulation.
